messages:
liam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring GPU capacity spikes last 3 Fridays around 09:18 UTC. Root signals point to scheduler backoff + quota throttling. I sketched action items below, assigning tentative owners. pls ack and update ETAs.

liam: ACTION 1 — scheduler knob tuning (reduce aggressive backoff, bump max pods/similar). owner: maya. ticket: RED-3762.
maya: ack. will run controlled tuning in staging this afternoon, then 2-hour soak. ETA: today EOD if soak looks good.

liam: ACTION 2 — short-term quota cushion: request +10% GPU quota from cloud for burst windows (weekdays 08-12 UTC). owner: jordan (infra). ticket: RED-3780.
jordan: started quota request workflow with cloud support, case #CLOUD-8921. If approved, we can schedule increase for next maintenance window (Thu midnight). ETA: waiting on cloud response ~48h.

liam: ACTION 3 — headroom documented runbook and per-customer guardrails (how to degrade non-critical routes). owner: helen. ticket: RED-3791.
helen: will draft runbook and a minimal failover policy (route to smaller models / rate-limit nonpaid tiers). sending first draft by tomorrow morning.

liam: ACTION 4 — add a recurring health-check job that exercises autoscaler and KV cache under short bursts (smoke test). owner: maya + jordan. job config in repo: infra/ops/gpu-smoke.
maya: will add the smoke job; sample command below to run locally:
```
./tools/gpu-stress --burst 120 --qps 50 --model gpt-3-small
```

jordan: will add CI step that runs a lighter variant against staging every weekday 09:00 UTC.

liam: NOTE: pattern shows two recurring flavors — short sharp bursts (2-5m) and long buildup (20-40m). short bursts often hit scheduler backoff, long builds hit quota headroom. we need both mitigations.

helen: can we add Grafana alert refinement? current alert fires too late. suggest alert when queue length > 50 for 3m and predicted GPU saturation > 75% for 5m.

jordan: agree. assigning alert tune to RED-3795. I'll update dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/gpu-overview

liam: Good. small housekeeping: please update tickets with exact rollout steps, risk and rollback plan. We'll do a canary on Dedicated first, then Hosted.

maya: confirmed. I'll test knob changes in staging -> canary on dedicated -> full rollout. will post timings in tickets.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: autop-run: follow-up sync for RED-3762/RED-3780/RED-3791 on 3422300000 (channel: #incidents).

liam: Thanks all. If cloud denies quota bump, fallback is automated shorter TTL for long-running cached prefixes + more aggressive shedding of low-priority requests (will outline in RED-3780).

helen: thumbs up. I'll also prepare a short postmortem addendum enumerating recurring incident signatures so they don't get lost.

liam: ack. Closing loop: owners: maya (scheduler knobs + smoke), jordan (quota + alerts + CI), helen (runbook + alert refinement). Next check-in: tomorrow 10:30 UTC.

maya: :+1:
helen: :+1:
jordan: :+1:
